incoming_runtime_policy.accepted_values: Positive integer seconds from the actual supervisor admission, up to and including the reviewed cohort maximum.
incoming_runtime_policy.insufficient_time: Record explicit per-arm deferred status when the profile-projected fit plus valid-export budget cannot fit; retain per-phase caps and never report a fit that did not run.
incoming_runtime_policy.phase_deadline: Worker start plus actual incoming runtime minus setup_timeout_seconds and terminal_packaging_reserve_seconds.

loader_rationale: Retains reviewed V2 cloud caps after actual A3D TCN B8 profile; fresh root admission and market/account checks required.
scope: H217 V4 resource contract; preserves V3 phase/resource ceilings and scientific recipe while accepting a positive supervisor-supplied runtime no greater than the 21600-second cohort maximum.
timing_contract: PROFILE.step_wall is per outer DataLoader batch and includes all internal windows/chunks; never multiply by ceil(20000/2000).
